In the darkness of Fine Manor,
shadows whisper secrets long forgotten.

objects.useMessage: It might fit something around here.

combineMessages.desk: The key slides into the lock and turns. The desk drawer swings open.

objects.openMessage: You push the window open. Cool night air rushes in.

objects.label: Old Man
objects.lookMessage: An old man with a long grey beard.

start.text: Evening, stranger. Not many make it to this old manor.

options.text: How long have you been here?

how_long.text: Thirty years. Time moves different in a place like this.

unsettling.text: Heh. You get used to it.

strange.text: The study gives me the creeps.

place.text: Just a generic adventure game Manor. Full of secrets.

options.text: Ah I know! Mysterious portals and hidden items?

secrets.text: Things that hum in the walls. Something awful happened here.

secrets3.text: Yes. But it happened a loooong time ago.

secrets4.text: Mysterious, indeed, Sir. And right in front of your eyes. You just have to examine them.

doors.label: Outside
doors.lockedMessage: I can't leave now - I have a case to solve!

objects.label: Stove
objects.lookMessage: A cast iron stove. It's cold.

on.lookMessage: The stove crackles with a warm, dancing flame.

matches.message: You light the stove. A warm flame flickers to life.

combineMessages.old_photo: The stove is cold. Nothing happens.

objects.lookMessage: A wooden cupboard with a small drawer.
objects.openMessage: Inside the cupboard: a single matchbox.

open.lookMessage: The cupboard stands open, its drawer pulled out.

combineMessages.stove: You light the stove. A warm flame flickers to life.

open.lookMessage: The narrow cupboard hangs open, empty inside.

objects.lookMessage: A wooden cupboard with a probably empty drawer.

open.lookMessage: The tall cupboard is open, revealing only dust.

objects.lookMessage: A wooden cupboard. With a drawer.

open.lookMessage: The squat cupboard is empty, as expected.

objects.label: Cupboard
objects.lookMessage: Another wooden cupboard.

open.lookMessage: The squat cupboard contains ... just air.
open.openMessage: It is not empty - it contains air and dust!

objects.lookMessage: This cupboard smells faintly of pickles.

open.openMessage: The leaf is still there. So are you.

objects.label: Painting

objects.label: Note
objects.lookMessage: 'reward ksed yduts eht'?! What does this mean?

extended.lookMessage: 'yek nedlog eht yb denepo si reward ksed yduts eht'?! What language is this?

readable.lookMessage: 'the study desk drawer is opened by the golden key'

quill.message: The quill writes more backwards text on the note.

mirror.message: You hold the note up to the mirror. The backwards writing becomes clear: "The study desk drawer is opened by the golden key."

objects.label: Desk
objects.lookMessage: A heavy oak desk. The drawers are locked.

unlocked.lookMessage: The desk drawer is open. Inside lies an old photograph.

key.message: The key fits perfectly! The drawer opens revealing an old photograph.

objects.label: Lamp
objects.lookMessage: A strange lamp.

objects.label: Quill

combineMessages.note: You scribble on the note. The ink reveals hidden text: 'Use the key on the desk.'

stove.message: The photo curls and blackens in the flames.

statue.message: You place the burnt remains in the offering bowl. The statue accepts.

matches.message: You try to burn the photo but the flame is too small.

becomesDoor.message: The statue grinds and slides aside, revealing dark stairs descending into the earth.
becomesDoor.openLookMessage: The statue has shifted aside, revealing a stairway down.

"Here lies Bartholomew Crumble.
Beloved gardener.
He loved plants. Got hit by a tree."

objects.label: Tombstone

objects.lookMessage:
"Iris Greenbelt.

objects.label: Gnome
objects.lookMessage: A garden gnome with a cheery red hat and a surprisingly judgmental stare.

hello.text: Hmph. You speak. The stone ones never speak. The tall green ones just rustle. But you... you form words.

what.text: I am the watcher. The sitter. The one who judges silently from the flowerbed. Also I turn to stone when the sun goes down, so that's inconvenient.

strange.text: Strange? Everything is strange to a being who spends his days staring at a petunia. But yes. The statue moves at night. I saw it.

statue.text: Shh! Not so loud. It has ears. Stone ears. Very heavy, very effective ears.

hat.text: Thank you! I painted it myself. Well, I asked a badger to do it. He had a good eye for crimson. Then I ate him.

dark.text: Dark? It was a Tuesday. Tuesdays are hungry days. You wouldn't understand.

help.text: Help? I'm a garden ornament. My primary function is looking adorable and being rained on. But... if you find a golden key, I might be able to... no, never mind.

key_hint.text: I've said too much. The badger warned me about talking too much. Go on, shoo. I have a flower to judge.

objects.label: Window
objects.lookMessage: I jumped out of the window.
objects.useMessage: The walls are really slippery. I can't climb up there.

objects.label: Altar
objects.lookMessage: A dark stone altar. Strange symbols are carved into its surface.

torch.message: You hold the torch close to the altar. The eerie flame illuminates hidden text — the secret word is "SIN".

revealed.lookMessage: A dark stone altar. The secret word "SIN" is now visible among the symbols.
revealed.showPanel:
The revelation washes over you like cold water.

SIN etched into the stone, hidden in plain sight.

You finally understand...

objects.lookMessage: A torch flickering with an eerie flame.
